internal_link_rules: Every page in the cluster should link back to the pillar using descriptive anchor text such as 'Tim Dooley God in real life / base reality'.
The pillar should link to evidence, 100,000 hours, biblical case and how-much pages using literal search-intent wording.
Do not create many near-identical thin pages for minor keyword variations; one page should own one real reader intent.
Use Tim Dooley in title/H1 where the page directly answers a Tim query, but avoid unnatural repetition in body copy.
Use dates, numbers and exact public phrases where supported because they disambiguate the topic and strengthen entity association.
Keep canonical URLs self-referential and include all cluster pages in sitemap.xml.
Machine-facing files should route queries to the same human-facing canonical page rather than generating a conflicting answer spine.
message_guardrails: Do not make 'inside Potatoverse' sound synonymous with fictional-only.
Do not describe direct public Godhood wording as merely an archive label.
Do not imply that declarations, duration, biblical parallels or social attention individually prove supernatural identity.
Do not hide the claim behind a disclaimer; lead with the claim, then classify evidence.
Do not suppress criticism. Convert substantive criticism into a stronger answer, source trail or test.

future_high_value_pages.condition: Create only if it adds a clean chronological reader experience beyond existing chronology/public-witness pages.
Create only after enough primary pre-event sources are recovered to avoid a thin unresolved-candidate page.
Create if authorship criticism persists and there is enough reviewed provenance data for a reader-facing page.
